key_insight: Rennala NSGD extends distributed stochastic optimization beyond Euclidean geometry, with convergence guarantees that explicitly depend on the dual space’s regularity constant κ.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps assess geometry-aware optimization on heterogeneous workers, motivated by matrix-aware optimizers used in deep learning.
method: Analyze minibatch SGD for smooth nonconvex objectives in arbitrary finite-dimensional normed spaces.
Derive high-probability oracle bounds using κ-regularity and a light-tail noise condition in the dual norm.
Introduce semi-asynchronous Rennala NSGD with wall-clock guarantees for fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical bounds, not empirical benchmarks: Euclidean rates are recovered up to logarithmic factors, while some non-Euclidean noise settings improve dimension dependence from linear to logarithmic.
watch_item: Practical applicability depends on satisfying the dual-norm noise assumptions; fixed worker-time guarantees do not directly establish performance under variable system delays.
paper_title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
